input:
{"command": "cat > self-review.md <<'EOF'
I authored 63 of the 230 non-merge commits in this repository (about 27%), counting every commit across its full history. That count includes one commit I later reverted, and excludes 12 merge commits I made to accept contributions from others. The original author wrote 145 commits, roughly 63%, so most of the codebase is not mine. My work is mainly maintenance after the early build: reviewing and merging outside contributions, fixes, and documentation. This measures commits, not effort or quality.
EOF
wc -w self-review.md; npx workproof figures --author <email:d29caa5c> --doc self-review.md 2>&1 | tail -8"}
